say:1:1710523001:1.text: I lost! Your skills are impressive.
say:1:1710523001:1.source_cn: 哎呀！竟然输了！看来你的牌技相当了得啊！
say:1:1710523001:1.male: I lost! Your skills are impressive.
say:1:1710523001:1.female: I lost! Your skills are impressive.

say:2:1710523002:1.text: But one loss means nothing. I brought plenty of tokens. Let's go again!
say:2:1710523002:1.source_cn: 不过，输一把不算什么！我可是带足了青符，咱们再来！
say:2:1710523002:1.male: But one loss means nothing. I brought plenty of tokens. Let's go again!
say:2:1710523002:1.female: But one loss means nothing. I brought plenty of tokens. Let's go again!

say:3:1710523003:0.text: You glance at the ten Azure Tokens you won, and remember the five thousand you need...
say:3:1710523003:0.source_cn: 你看着手里刚赢来的十枚青符，又回想了一下能见到馆主需要...
say:3:1710523003:0.male: You glance at the ten Azure Tokens you won, and remember the five thousand you need...
say:3:1710523003:0.female: You glance at the ten Azure Tokens you won, and remember the five thousand you need...

say:4:1710523004:1.text: At this pace, it'll take forever. Maybe there's a way to speed things up?
say:4:1710523004:1.source_cn: 照现在这个速度，你短期内是不可能凑齐了。或许，可以想办...
say:4:1710523004:1.male: At this pace, it'll take forever. Maybe there's a way to speed things up?
say:4:1710523004:1.female: At this pace, it'll take forever. Maybe there's a way to speed things up?

say:6:1710523006:1.text: You agree, but your approach will be:
say:6:1710523006:1.source_cn: 你立刻答应了海怪的邀请，只不过你接下来打牌的方式是——

say:8:1710523007:1.text: In a hall wrapped in illusion magic, who would notice a little extra spellwork?
say:8:1710523007:1.source_cn: 在这个被幻象魔法笼罩的会馆内，施展一点“特殊魔法”，应...
say:8:1710523007:1.male: In a hall wrapped in illusion magic, who would notice a little extra spellwork?
say:8:1710523007:1.female: In a hall wrapped in illusion magic, who would notice a little extra spellwork?

say:9:1710523009:1.source_cn: 那就让我们决战到天亮！

say:11:1710523008:1.text: ... Better not. This is the Solitaries' territory. Careless magic could cause trouble.
say:11:1710523008:1.source_cn: ……算了，这里毕竟是隐士的地盘，乱用魔法可能会惹麻烦。
